title: Consolidate documentation into README, ARCHITECTURE, SECURITY and OPERATIONS
description:
About 20 Markdown files describe the project, many as historical proof narratives. Several are stale: ACCOUNTS_UI.md and GOOGLE_IDENTITY.md say Accounts activation remains disabled while `deployment.json` has `enabled: true`; TRACKING.md references another board's issue IDs; DURABLE_ACCOUNTS.md names a nonexistent script; many files have stripped spaces around numbers and hashes.

Scope: consolidate into `README.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/SECURITY.md` and `docs/OPERATIONS.md` with facts taken from the code; keep `.feature` files and `docs/accounts/PAPYRUS_SITES.md`; move proof history into one dated appendix; delete the superseded files after fixing every link to them.

Acceptance: no dangling links; every claim checkable against the code; the account model decision (one account, per-product entitlements, operators grant products) is written down.
